about: A loop over a snippet folder reads each item's body as item.content, rendered where it is read; one tag stands for a different body per item, so that body only presents (chapter 5 § 5.6.2; this implementation's sentence). The loop standards' agent section reads item.content. Invalid: hpi's body writes run.date. Valid: it writes only text.
sentences: Snippet 'standards/hpi' reads run.date, and Node 'section' reads it as item.content at line 3; a folder item's body read in a loop places no part, macro or snippet, pipes into no renderer and reads no run.* or run-dependent value.
